<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]], [[Battle of Al Hudaydah]]
**Alleged [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi-led]] coalition airstrikes on a fish market and hospital entrance kill at least 20 people in [[Al Hudaydah]], [[Yemen]]. A Saudi spokesman denies that its jets were in the area at the time, and blames rebels instead. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-45050927 (BBC)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**In northern [[Myanmar]], around 300 villagers flee from their homes in [[Namtu Township]], [[Shan State]], after [[Northern Alliance (Myanmar)|Northern Alliance]] insurgents take positions in the area, renewing fears of clashes between insurgents and government soldiers. [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/villagers-08022018171037.html (Radio Free Asia)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Theology of Pope Francis]]
**[[Pope Francis]] changes [[Catholic Church]] teaching to fully reject the death penalty, saying that it would work to abolish the [[Capital punishment|death penalty]] [[Capital punishment by country|worldwide]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/pope-francis-changes-catholic-church-teaching-to-say-death-penalty-is-inadmissible/2018/08/02/0d69ef5e-9647-11e8-80e1-00e80e1fdf43_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*''[[Yomiuri Shimbun]]'' reports [[Tokyo Medical University]] altered entrance examination scores to decrease the number of women attending the school. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45043818 (BBC)]
*[[Archeologist]]s of the [[Romano-Germanic Museum]] report the discovery of the foundations of a [[Roman Empire|Roman]] library building in [[Cologne, Germany|Cologne]]. Dating from the [[2nd century]] [[Common Era|CE]], it is the oldest library yet discovered in [[Germany]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-45029960 (BBC)] 

;Business and economy
*[[List of public corporations by market capitalization]]
**[[Apple Inc.]] becomes the first public company to be worth [[US$]]1 trillion. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45050213 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[2018 Pacific hurricane season#Hurricane Hector|Hurricane Hector]] becomes the fourth named hurricane of the eastern [[Pacific Ocean|Pacific]]'s hurricane season. [https://www.tcpalm.com/story/weather/2018/08/02/hurricane-season-enters-busy-period-heat-index-could-hit-101-today/887583002/ (TC Palm)]
**Hector is forecast to strengthen into a [[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 3|category 3 storm]] the next few days. [http://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/story/38797281/hector-forecast-to-strengthen-into-major-hurricane-in-east-pacific (Hawaii News Now)]

;International Relations
* [[Crisis in Venezuela (2012-present)]], [[Colombia-Venezuela relations]]
** Departing Colombian President [[Juan Manuel Santos]] grants 2-year citizenship rights to over 440,000 displaced Venezuelans living in Colombia, giving them certainty in access to medical and financial aid. [https://reliefweb.int/sites/reliefweb.int/files/resources/65043.pdf (United Nations)], [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/colombian-president-lends-hand-refugees-venezuela-56993094 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Tennessee gubernatorial election, 2018]]
**Former construction executive [[Bill Lee (Tennessee politician)|Bill Lee]] wins the [[Tennessee Republican Party|Republican]] primary for [[Governor of Tennessee|Tennessee governor]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/bill-lee-wins-gop-primary-for-tennessee-governor-1533262353 (WSJ)]
*[[2018 United States gun violence protests]]
**Anti-violence protesters take to the streets of [[Chicago]] to draw attention to the problem of gun violence in Chicago, which briefly shuts down [[Lake Shore Drive]]. Protesters also call for [[Chicago Police Department|Chicago Police Superintendent]] [[Eddie T. Johnson]] and [[Mayor of Chicago|Mayor]] [[Rahm Emanuel]] to step down for their handling of racial incidents in communities of color. [https://thegrio.com/2018/08/03/anti-violence-protestors-march-to-chicagos-wrigley-field-to-demand-change/ (The Grio)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/protesters-march-against-gun-violence-in-chicago/4511967.html (VOA News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[Kepler-452b]] emerges as an [[exoplanet]] that might support alien life. [https://news.sky.com/story/super-earth-most-likely-candidate-for-hosting-alien-life-11457066 (Sky News)]
*[[Greenhouse gas]], [[Plastic pollution]]
**A study is published suggesting that loose [[plastic]] objects in the ocean release more [[methane]] than previously thought. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45043989 (BBC)]
*Tests on the 5,000-year-old burnt human bones of 25 people found at [[Stonehenge]] suggest that ten came from more than {{convert|100|mi|km}} away in [[West Wales]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/aug/02/revealed-stonehenge-buried-welsh (''The Guardian'')]
